acceptance: Frontend dev server serves the PAL app in a real browser at its bound port with no console errors, page errors or failed requests
Backend FastAPI runs against the user's PostgreSQL (Docker/WSL relay on 5432) and returns 3 real company rows from a DB-backed endpoint
Core UI routes (dashboard, invoices, bank, review, vendors, audit, tally) render against live data; mobile 390px viewport shows no horizontal overflow
Live TallyPrime integration works end to end: tally/status reports connected and tally/companies returns parsed company names over the real XML round trip
change.reason: Corrections from observed reality, not assumptions. (1) My previous criterion assumed TallyPrime would be down and expected connected:false; you then started TallyPrime, and the endpoint now returns connected:true with a live XML read succeeding (companies: BIMAKAVACH INSURANCE BROKING PRIVATE LIMTED - (from 1-Apr-23), PAL Test Company), so the criterion is rewritten to assert the integration actually works rather than that it is absent. (2) The companies count is stable at 3 across repeated raw-body reads (len=1513 each time); the earlier "1" was PowerShell unrolling a single-object response in a subexpression, not a flaky API, so the criterion now pins the value to 3.
